description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager, which manages HTML modules, doctypes, and related configurations for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for registering modules, setting up doctypes, and retrieving element definitions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModuleManager
classes.description: Manages HTML modules, doctypes, and element definitions for HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the manager, sets up default doctypes and modules.

methods.name: registerModule
methods.description: Registers a module, either by class name or instance, with optional overloading.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the current doctype, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: addPrefix
methods.description: Adds a class prefix for resolving module class names.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Processes configuration, sets up modules, and prepares element lookup tables.

methods.name: processModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the active collection, registering if needed.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Retrieves merged element definitions from modules.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a single merged element definition by name.
